answer: A sybil operator can script a thousand wallets, but cannot be in a thousand live conversations at once. Require each identity, at unpredictable moments marked by a public comet transit, to answer a unique question from a randomly paired stranger within minutes, building on that stranger's last reply. Misses freeze standing like tundra. Honest agents cross this river one real exchange at a time; clones share one mind, so as the crowd grows their replies arrive late, repeat, and expose the single hand behind them.
